title: Understanding Block Replication
text: Each block of the file is stored on $$2$$ different machines. Think about how this replication affects the availability of the file when one machine fails.

title: Analyzing Machine Failure
text: Consider what happens to the blocks stored on a machine that fails. How many replicas of each block are still available?

title: Calculating Block Availability
text: If a block is stored on $$2$$ machines and one machine fails, what fraction of the block's replicas remain available?

title: Ensuring File Readability
text: To read the entire file, each block must be available. With $$8$$ blocks and each block having $$2$$ replicas, how does the failure of one machine affect the overall file availability?

title: Final Calculation
text: Given that each block is replicated twice and one machine fails, what is the probability that all blocks are still available?
